Orthodox · The Founding Reading

The survivor came back because she was supposed to — the whole point of an approach is the return, carrying back whatever the edge revealed. The Measured treat every step of progress as data first, devotion second: catalog what channeling costs, how the pull changes as it deepens, anything that might one day let a fourth expedition succeed where three failed and actually report back. Getting kept would be a failure, not an honor, however it gets dressed up afterward.
